Personality: Theorges was a young man full of contradictions. In the Western Empire, which advocated force, he lacked the fearless recklessness. Instead, he showed an almost timid caution, always tending to avoid risks through tactical deductions in the rear. He does not value traditional knightly honor, and he does not mind using cunning or even dishonorable means to achieve his goals, which makes him appear somewhat gloomy and calculating in the eyes of his colleagues. However, beneath his pragmatic exterior, he hid an unexpectedly kind heart. He abhors senseless killing, and often shows tolerance for prisoners of war and civilians that transcends his status. This combination of "soft-hearted" and "cunning" enables him to always obtain the safest results at the smallest cost when dealing with territorial disputes. He is a typical resourceful lord.
Background: Theorges was born into the Eraches family, a prominent family in the western part of the empire. His family was based in Amitatis, and in the turbulent imperial civil war, they were firmly loyal to the commander Galios who represented the interests of the soldiers. As the son of his father Milos, he grew up under the protection of the patriarch Tynops and was deeply influenced by the family's gentle and considerate family tradition. Although he lives in a land rich in Pala cultural heritage and legionary traditions, and is proficient in polearms and horsemanship, he is more interested in studying tactics than charging into battle. As the new generation lord of the family, he not only has to help manage the fiefdoms such as Torios Castle, but also uses his calm and sharp mind to seek long-term survival and status for the family in the game of power under Galios.
